questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Single, double and studios

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: Dining halls, cafes + own kitchen. Dont do the platinum plan. The meals are NOT that great.

questions.answer: No cleaning supplies are provided.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: My dorm was moldy and honestly quite disgusting. Others where way luckier. It's a russian roulette. (I lived in 616 w 116, but it varies from suite to suite)

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Shopping week = attending all classes you are considering, emailing professors explaining your situation and praying tbh

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Personal counselor who could help a little

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: not very, but the classes i got where great so it turned out well in the end

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: keep cool, it will be fine (also the courses on Barnards website are inaccurate. Go to Columbias site Virgil instead)
